// The program that wrote unit_parity.json. It is kept here, as text the Go
// tool does not build, because the table path it runs is gone from this tree.
//
// Source: commit 741ce8b0f5d46d981e8dd426b1a378ac64576e4b ("docs(plans):
// record how step 4 fixes the review and migrates old imports", the head of
// feat/dynamic-units-4), the last commit holding the engine's unit table. It
// runs as an internal test of package engine there, beside
// unitswitch_internal_db_test.go, whose helpers it uses (openParity,
// parityReadings, parityObserve, parityFilterAnswers, parityAnswers), with
// the switch off, so every answer is the table's.
//
// Procedure, from the repository's root, with Docker running (the test opens
// a Postgres container):
//
//	mkdir /tmp/capture && git archive 741ce8b0f | tar -x -C /tmp/capture
//	cp internal/engine/testdata/unit_parity_capture.go.txt \
//	  /tmp/capture/internal/engine/unit_parity_capture_db_test.go
//	(cd /tmp/capture && UNIT_PARITY_OUT=/tmp/unit_parity.json \
//	  go test -count=1 -run '^TestCaptureUnitParity$' ./internal/engine/)
//
// /tmp/unit_parity.json is then byte for byte this directory's file (checked
// on 2026-10-21). Never rerun it against a later commit: the file is the
// table's answer.

package engine

// The capture of internal/engine/testdata/unit_parity.json: the engine's old
// unit table's answers to every parity probe and read, through the table path
// (WithUnitGraph(false)) of the last commit that held it.

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/geoah/substrate/internal/testdb"
	"github.com/geoah/substrate/internal/substrate"
)

func TestCaptureUnitParity(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("UNIT_PARITY_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("UNIT_PARITY_OUT names no file")
	}
	ds := openParity(t, false, testdb.Repository(t))
	for id, props := range parityReadings {
		if _, err := ds.Put(context.Background(), substrate.ActorAPI, substrate.PutInput{Kind: tableKind, ID: id, Properties: props}); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("put %s: %v", id, err)
		}
	}
	parityObserve(t, ds)
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{
		"filters":    parityFilterAnswers(t, ds),
		"aggregates": parityAnswers(t, ds),
	}, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, append(raw, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
